title: Build a Reusable Pipeline
prompt:
Write two functions and compose them:

- `topSpenders(orders, min)` — returns users whose order total is at least `min`, deduplicated, in first-seen order
- `countBy(orders, keyFn)` — returns an object counting items by the key returned from `keyFn(item)`

Both must be built on `filter`/`map`/`reduce`.

tests.name: topSpenders filters and dedupes
tests.hint: filter by total >= min, then map to user, then dedupe with a Set or reduce.

tests.name: countBy counts by derived key
